steps.content: It doesn't take long to reach your destination. There are no monsters at the door, no crewmates. Only horrifying dents in the metal, proof that the attack wasn't a nightmare.
[Small CG 01]
Black, human-shaped stains cover the floor. The crew members who were still fighting when you left—including Captain Edmond—are all gone.

In the empty wheelhouse, only one person remains. Shin leans against the console, her face and chest smeared with blood. Blood is still gushing from an appalling wound in her abdomen, soaking her white shirt crimson.
Beside her, various items are haphazardly piled together:

Reid's axe is jammed into a metal groove beside the helm, its dull blade propping up a bent metal pipe, the makeshift crutch of a wounded crewmate. Together with the broken railing, they brace the helm, keeping it from slipping.
Laura's safety goggles, the ones she always wore during experiments, are now wedged into a crack in the console, watch over the approaching shore with her final will.

On the other side, pieces of clothing, drenched in blood and black ichor, are torn into strips and knotted into ropes. Tied to the helm from anchor points across the console, they hold the helm in place, ensuring the broken vessel stays on course.
Every item bears a familiar memory of its owner, a record of life's final act of will.
And Shin assembled this makeshift fortress on the verge of death, with the last dregs of her strength.

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: Who's... there? Is someone... still alive? That's great...
You and Pylgia rush forward almost simultaneously.
Pylgia tosses her harpoon aside and grabs the sputtering helm, holding it steady through gritted teeth.
You catch Shin's swaying body, carefully helping her sit against the wall.
Only now do you get a clear look at her injuries. Her abdomen is torn open by a deep, jagged wound. You can even see the warm pulse of her gut, threatening to spill out.
Blood flows steadily from her wounds, pooling with the black ichor on the floor and soaking your clothes.
Panic seizes you, your hands shaking uncontrollably as you desperately try to push her warm insides back where they belong.
You rip strips from your own clothing, rolling them up to dress the gash, doing everything you can to stanch her wound.
Tears and blood blur your vision, but you never stop working, praying you won't lose another companion.
In your daze, a cold hand touches your face.
[Small CG 02]

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: Is that you... my little guide?
You wipe away your tears and see Shin open her eyes. So much blood loss has left her gaze hollow. She can't even see you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: It's me... it's me, I'm back...
Even the usually collected Pylgia has lost her composure.

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: What happened? Why are you...

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: I'm sorry... I couldn't save them...

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: I don't know... why it had to be them... Why am I the only one left...? What did I... do wrong...?
Undisguised grief and anguish wash over the face of this beloved leader, who has witnessed her trusted companions vanish one by one.
The Shin you remember was always calm, able to understand everyone's feelings and forgive their mistakes. But now, trapped in the shadow of her own failure, she feels like a stranger.
You gently take her blood-stained hand, your voice equally choked with emotion.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You've done enough, Shin. They fought to get us this far... We have to live, we have to keep going. For them.
Shin trembles at the sound of your words.
She slowly closes her eyes, then opens them again, whispering in a faint yet determined voice.

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: You're right... We still have a chance...

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: At least you're still here... At least... the ship hasn't gone off course...

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: Can you...
She struggles to turn her head, trying to look out the window.

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: Can you help me see... is this... the right direction...?
Outside, veiled in a thin mist, the shadow of land draws closer. In these terrible circumstances, it's the only good news there is.
Shin's final decision, made while she was dying, kept the ship from drifting off course and preserved your last ray of hope.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The course is right. We'll reach land soon.

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: That's... good...
Tears flow from her vacant eyes, streaming through dried blood to form two dark red streaks down her cheeks.
Still, she forces the corners of her mouth up into the smile you and Pylgia know so well.

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: Perhaps I need... to rest for a while...
The horrific wounds, the endless mental torment... what Shin has gone through is beyond the limits of human endurance.
She can't hold on any longer. Her body goes slack, and she leans into your embrace, barely able to sit up.
As her body grows heavier, you wrap your arms tightly around her shoulders, panic and helplessness rising again. But in this moment, she uses her last bit of strength to grip your arm.

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: Promise me...
In her dilated pupils, nothing but desperate, fervent pleading remains.

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: Take this ship... to land... Please...
With these words, Shin collapses in your arms, unconscious.
